Stunfisk keeps its mouth turned up in a permanent frown. It has a flat body that lets it blend into the muck.
It practices by flinging its limbs at the air and is quick to learn new moves. Its supple body lets it strike from many angles.
Mienfoo sets itself in a stance and bows. Its steps are light, and it dodges blows with a twist of its waist.
The fur on its arms is used like a whip and cracks through the air. Its kicks and strikes are lightning fast.
Mienshao keeps up a constant flow of strikes. Its trained body is flexible and hardy, and its mind is calm.
It lives in a cave and ambushes whoever passes. It lies in wait with its mouth shut, then lunges with a roar.
Druddigon has a rough, red hide that is tough as rock. It sleeps in the sun to warm its body, and its wings are used as a cloak.
It was made out of clay by someone long ago, and it moves on a strange, slow march. No one knows why it was built or who built it.
Golett roams around ancient ruins with a blank, dull stare. When it gets going, its stiff legs thump on the ground.
It guards its home with a steady watch, and a plate set into its chest is what holds its wild power back. It flies when it is sent after a threat.
Golurk stomps forth with a heavy tread. Legend says it protects the people that live near its ruins.
Its body is covered in blades that it keeps sharp, and a gang of them will fight as one. It gladly follows a strong leader.
Pawniard slashes at its foes with its arms and head. It rubs its blades against each other to hone them.
It rules over a pack of lesser blades and commands them with cold looks. A leader of cold steel, it will cut down anyone who disobeys.
Bisharp shows no mercy, and it fights without pity. Its sharp arms can shear iron plates.
It charges head first with its great curly afro and shrugs off blows that would topple a wall. It will wreck a truck with its thick skull.
Bouffalant herds are stubborn and will not give way. It prefers to settle disputes by butting heads.
Small as it is, it picks fights with much bigger rivals and often loses. It trains by diving at foes again and again.
Rufflet is bold and reckless and flaps its wings loudly. It gets back up and tries again.
It is a brave flyer that fights to the end to defend its flock. Even when it is wounded, it stays in the air.
Braviary is a symbol of courage and protects its friends. It dives with great speed and grabs prey in its talons.
It wears a bone on its tail as a diaper of sorts, and the young one cannot fly well. It gets by on carrion and leftover scraps.
Vullaby lurks among the rocks until a bigger predator leaves its meal. It flaps awkwardly and often falls.
It circles over its territory, looking for scraps. It carries bones for the wear of its young and uses them as weapons.
Mandibuzz keeps a cool eye on the landscape below. It hunts the sick or weakened and never wastes a thing.
Its tongue is a flame that it uses to hunt for ants, and it licks them up with a hiss. It lives where it can find its favorite prey.
Heatmor slurps up anything it can reach. A flame burns inside its mouth, and it snorts out a stream of fire.
It lives in colonies in deep burrows and bites with steel jaws. A group will team up to take on prey much bigger than themselves.
Durant digs endless tunnels through the rock. Its enemy is a certain large insect that raids its nest.
It has no sight and bumps into everything, and it tries to bite whatever it touches. It is a danger to anyone who is nearby.
Deino is a hungry little fellow that gnaws at anything within reach. Its roughness comes from not knowing what it is chewing.
Each head has a mind of its own, and the two are always bickering. When they pull in different directions, it goes in circles.
Zweilous feeds twice as much as other Pokémon and fights for each bite. It lives in the dark and bites the unwary.
Three heads and six wings make it a fearsome sight. It rampages over towns, eating everything it meets, and then flies on in a rage.
Hydreigon's heads work together to devour a foe. It is called a brutal beast, and no one dares to stand in its way.
It basks in the heat of a volcano and spits out fireballs when angry. Its body is as warm as a heater and its sting is hot enough to burn.
Larvesta is wrapped in white fluff. When it is time, it gathers heat and heads up in search of a place to sleep.
It scatters a fiery dust as it flaps and lights the sky like a little sun. Long ago, it is said to have shone in place of the sun when it was hidden.
Volcarona's six wings beat in a steady rhythm and keep the air around it hot. It is a gentle sight when it floats in the dusk.
It is said to protect Pokémon from the cruelty of people, and it appears as a blue knight with steel horns. Its body is tough as a shield.
Cobalion has a kind heart and a stern gaze. It leads its allies with firm and calm confidence.
It once smashed a castle wall to save its friends, and its charge can break through any rock. It has a powerful, muscular frame.
Terrakion lives high in the cliffs and clears away obstacles with a charge. It has a strong sense of justice.
It moves through the grass like the wind and can slash with the sharp horns on its head. It does not make a sound as it runs.
Virizion is a graceful, gentle fighter, and strong enough to make a foe back off without a word. It gets along with those who treat nature with care.
It flies through the sky on a whirl of wind and brings storms wherever it goes. It spins its tail like a propeller and makes a roaring gale.
Tornadus has a wild temper and vanishes in a blink. Its swirling winds can rip roofs from houses.
It is a restless thing that rides the clouds, and where its bolts strike, the ground is scorched. It flies at the center of its own storm.
Thundurus cackles and darts about, flinging lightning. Its tail glows like a spark in the dark.
A white dragon that is said to represent truth. Its tail ignites with a flame so powerful it can scorch the very sky.
Reshiram's flames can melt the strongest stone. It is said to have helped build a land with an ideal of truth.
A black dragon that is said to represent ideals. Its tail is a generator of lightning, and it can shake the sky with thunder.
Zekrom is a mighty creature that is said to have helped a hero. Where it flies, the clouds turn dark.
It brings a good harvest wherever it passes, and its soil is rich and fruitful. Farmers revere it as a god of the fields.
Landorus stays low over the land and steers the winds to bring rain. Fields it has crossed are known to flourish.
It sleeps in a freezing cave and has a body that is hollow like a gaping void. It freezes anything that comes near.
Kyurem exhales a breath so cold it can turn the air to ice. Its empty frame hungers for something to fill it.
It is a swift colt that runs across the water as if on land, and it fights fiercely for its friends. A keen, sharp horn rises from its brow.
Keldeo's speed is incredible, and its hooves skim above the waves. It is a loyal and brave fighter.
Its voice is an enchanting melody that can lift the spirits of all who hear it. It dances on a gentle breeze and its songs can change a mood.
Meloetta sings with such beauty that it soothes the angriest of hearts. When it dances, its form shifts to match the rhythm.
An ancient bug brought back with a cannon on its back, it was altered by some unknown party. It flies with great speed and fires a beam of energy.
Genesect was a fearsome hunter long ago, and now a rebuilt one roams the world. Its body is armored in strong steel.
A tough, spiky cap sits on its head like a helmet, and it lowers it to charge at trouble. The spikes soften when it is relaxed and being petted.
Chespin fills its cheeks with nuts and munches steadily through the day. It is a bold and playful youngster that likes tumbling about with friends.
The sharp quills on its back stand out like a suit of armor, and it will roll into a ball when threatened. Its curious eyes miss very little.
Quilladin is protective and loyal. It plants itself in front of its friends and takes the hit for them without complaint.
A shell of green spikes covers its body and stops a falling boulder. It braces its feet and raises its arms to shield those behind it.
Chesnaught is a gentle giant that will wait patiently, then answer an attack with a single heavy punch. It guards the woods with great care.
Warm air flows out of its big ears when it is excited. It nibbles on a twig and the tip of the stick lights up in a small puff of flame.
Fennekin curls up with its tail wrapped around its nose to keep warm. A cheery little fox, it follows close behind its trainer.
It carries a twig tucked in its fluffy tail and draws it like a wand. A swirl of the stick sets off a ring of flickering flame.
Braixen rubs the twig to build up heat, then gestures with it as if conducting an orchestra. It prefers to keep its ears pointed at every sound.
It stares into the flames on the tip of its wand and goes into a trance, seeing scenes far away. Its powers reach beyond the flames themselves.
Delphox moves with a calm, regal grace. When it waves its wand, the air itself seems to bend and swirl.
Bubbles cover its chest and back, and they soften blows. It jumps from lily pad to lily pad and loves to splash in the rain.
Froakie is calm and quick to settle into a new place. If startled, it pops a bubble in a loud snap and leaps away.
It flings bubbles that harden like stones, and hits a target from a long way off. It practices its aim at dawn on a quiet pond.
Frogadier keeps its footing even on slippery rocks. It trains hard in secret, and rarely lets anyone see its practice.
It folds up water into razor-thin shuriken and throws them without a sound. A rooftop leap in the dark is its idea of a good night's work.
Greninja moves like a shadow, seen only in the glint of moonlight. Its long tongue is wound about its neck like a scarf.
Its big ears are used as spades, and it can dig a hole in a matter of seconds. It is always busy turning up the soil of a field.
Bunnelby digs burrows for rest and for food storage and gets upset if someone steps on the entrance. It stuffs a small stash of seeds inside.
Its strong ears can lift boulders and dig tunnels at an alarming speed. Farmers like it, for it plows hard ground and clears away rocks.
Diggersby's burrow is a maze of tunnels that stretches under a whole meadow. It eats clover and any root it digs up.
It is small and bold, and it sings a tune with a loud clear voice. Territorial fights break out often, and it fluffs its feathers to look bigger.
Fletchling feeds on seeds and sings from fences. If another bird lands in its yard, it chases it off with a loud trill.
Hot cinders flutter from its wings as it flies. It rests in warm places and gathers sparks in its feathers.
Fletchinder is quick to anger and keeps a close watch on its territory. It zooms down at a high speed, trailing a scatter of glowing embers.
When it dives, it becomes a streak of flame in the sky and strikes with the speed of an arrow. Its sharp talons rarely miss.
Talonflame fans its wings to make its feathers glow. In a fight it flies up high, wheels around and drops on its target.
It puffs a fine, harmless powder off its body as a shield. The dust keeps it safe from heat and cold alike.
Scatterbug is a gentle grazer that nibbles on leaves in the shade. Wherever it goes, a thin trail of dust is left behind.
It hangs motionless inside a thick, fuzzy shell that guards its soft body. It braces itself if an enemy approaches, and it does not flinch.
Spewpa keeps its fur fluffed against the cold and the damp. It is waiting for the day when its wings will unfold.
The pattern on its wings depends on the climate where it grew up. Travelers can tell from the print where a Vivillon was born.
Vivillon scatters a shimmering dust that can put a foe to sleep. It flutters from flower to flower and drinks the nectar.
The fur on its head is a fine tuft of warm red, and it is proud of it. A young one practices roaring, but only a squeak comes out.
Litleo is a cub in the hot, dry plains, always hot-headed and bold. It learns about the world by trying to wrestle everything in it.
A male leads his pride with a magnificent flaming mane, while the females do the hunting. A roar from it can be heard across a valley.
Pyroar is protective of its pack and strikes the ground to warn off any threat. It grows hotter as its anger rises.
It sits on a single flower and lives and dies with it. If the bloom wilts, it searches carefully for a new one that suits it.
Flabébé floats lightly on the wind, tending its flower with great care. It is always searching for a good spot in the sun.
The flower it holds is its pride, and it takes good care of it. When it finds a bed of blossoms it likes, it settles down and rests.
Floette twirls about and tosses petals to whoever is nearby. It will not leave a field of flowers that is under attack.
It creates a garden of its own and tends the flowers as a queen would her realm. The more it blooms, the more it glows.
Florges surrounds itself with a huge floral skirt and sways in the breeze. Its garden is filled with a sweet and gentle scent.
It carries a leafy plant on its back, and the plant grows lusher when it is well fed and cheerful. It can pull a plow all day.
Skiddo is a calm, sensible creature that follows its herd. It is not hard to get along with, and it makes a good riding companion.
People can ride on its back, holding its horns like reins. It steps lightly over rough mountain trails with a sure hoof.
Gogoat senses a rider's mood and moves in time with it. Farmers prize it for its strength and good temper.
It wants to be taken seriously and glares fiercely with a leaf in its mouth. When it gets a pat on the head, it forgets its frown.
Pancham tries to imitate a tough guy and fails because it is so cute. It plays with all its heart and forgets to be tough.
It walks with a heavy stride and does not shy away from a challenge. A strong, honest bamboo leaf is held between its teeth.
Pangoro uses its great arms to hit hard, but it also lifts a lost traveler to safety. It cannot stand to see a weaker one being bullied.
Its thick fur can be trimmed in many styles, and the shape changes how it looks and moves. Originally a pet of royalty, it knows how to behave.
Furfrou keeps its coat fluffy and well groomed. A fine haircut makes it prance with delight.
It holds back a huge psychic power that leaks out of its ears. It keeps them covered and walks with a timid, silent step.
Espurr stares with wide, unblinking eyes, which seem blank but are deep and seeing. If its ears are touched, it may become wary.
It flips open the ears and its powers blossom. A male looks calm and thoughtful, and a female is a little more outspoken.
Meowstic stands guard with a keen gaze. When someone in its group is hurt, its eyes light up and it sends a wave of force.
A weapon with a will of its own, it wraps a cloth around the hand of whoever picks it up. Its edge is always keen.
Honedge hangs about old armories and moves on its own. If anyone grabs its hilt, it clings and doesn't let go.
Two swords work in step, and each fights as a partner to the other. They circle an enemy and strike together.
Doublade crosses its blades and spins to slash. The pair stays together, and if parted, they will search for each other.
It holds a shield in front for defense and flips to a sword when it attacks. Its ghostly gaze can see through any feint.
Aegislash once guarded a king, and it remembers the oath. Its stance changes in an instant from shield to blade.
A pleasant scent wafts from its body and can calm an angry person. Its fragrance is quite individual and depends on its mood.
Spritzee sniffs the air for a smell it likes and follows it. A whiff of something awful makes it sulk.
It can make a perfume that is a joy to some and a torment to others. Pleasant or pungent, it uses its scent as a weapon.
Aromatisse hums to itself and releases smells that change the mood of the air. It lives among flowers and herbs.
Its fur is made of a sweet floss that sticks to everything it touches. It eats a lot of sugar to keep its coat fluffy.
Swirlix is gentle and affectionate and clings to those it trusts. A treat is a sure way to win its heart.
Its sense of smell is keen, and it can taste even small differences in sweets. Master bakers keep one by their side.
Slurpuff whips up a fluffy cream with its tail. It is fiercely proud of its taste and can be tough on a poor recipe.
It lights up the spots on its body to confuse foes. If it flashes them while spinning, those who watch lose track of up and down.
Inkay floats about in the shallows, flashing its colors. It hides in the dark of tidal pools to rest.
Its eyes flicker with a hypnotic glow, and it uses them to control other minds. It can turn a whole crowd to its will.
Malamar flips over to show its true shape. It slinks into the sea with a creeping grace.
Two of them live on the same rock, and they have a little squabble each time they meet. Their nails are sharp enough to cut through ship hulls.
Binacle clamps to a rock and pries open shells with its small arms. It folds its arms and waits patiently for the tide.
A tangle of tiny arms gives it a fierce grip, and each hand seems to think for itself. They bicker over which way to go.
Barbaracle's many hands can punch or grab in all directions. It guards the coast against uninvited visitors.
It looks like a dead piece of seaweed, and it spits a poison if a foe comes too near. A good hiding place is the thing it values most.
Skrelp drifts on the sea floor, still and patient. It picks up and carries small stones to throw.
Poison seeps from its body and fouls the water around it, and any ship that passes will vanish. Local sailors steer well clear of it.
Dragalge lurks deep in stormy seas. Its swaying fronds hide a great and venomous dragon.
Its oversized claw snaps shut with such force that it shoots out a jet of water to knock down prey. It aims with one eye closed.
Clauncher is a stubborn fighter that rarely backs off. It stays hidden in shallow water, and its big claw pokes up like a periscope.
It holds a cannon-like claw ready and fires a blast of water that can sink a small boat. The shot is heard from far across the bay.
Clawitzer builds up pressure in its claw for a moment before shooting. It keeps firing until its target is out of sight.
It spreads the frills around its neck to soak up sunlight and turn it to electricity. A cloudy day leaves it sleepy and slow.
Helioptile scurries across hot sand with a bounce in its step. At night, it curls up in a nook and waits for the sun.
Its big frills drink in sunlight and fire it out as flashing light that can dazzle a foe. It runs at astonishing speed across open desert.
Heliolisk lives in dry lands and can power small machines with its charge. Its frills glimmer when it is angry.
Brought back from a fossil of the distant past, it carries itself like a prince. If it doesn't get its way, it stomps about and bites furniture.
Tyrunt has a big, strong jaw that can chew through a boulder. It is a spoiled youngster, but not hard to like.
It ruled over the land long ago, and no creature dared to challenge it. A single bite from those jaws could flatten a car.
Tyrantrum is a feared hunter with a thunderous roar. Its massive head is carried high as it surveys its realm.
It was found frozen in a block of ice from an age long past. The fins that trail from its neck shimmer with light like a curtain.
Amaura is quiet and sleepy and spends most of its time on cold shores. It glides across snow with a smooth, slow walk.
It breathes out a freezing mist and makes a wall of ice in an instant. A glittering sail on its neck draws many an eye.
Aurorus lived in cold lands where the ice never melted. Hunger drives it to wander far over the snow.
Soft ribbons curl from its body and reach out to hold the hand of someone it loves. Their gentle touch can calm even a furious foe.
Sylveon sends a soothing charm across the air to ease tension. It hates a quarrel, and moves in to cool things down.
It dives from great heights in a showy pose and loves to hear a crowd cheer. Its wings are small for flight, but they make superb arms for a spin.
Hawlucha strikes a dramatic stance before a match. It practices on the mountain and hates to lose in front of an audience.
It picks up electricity with the whiskers on its cheeks and can even draw power from outlets. It shares its stash with its friends.
Dedenne uses its whiskers like antennae to send and receive signals. It tucks its tail around itself and takes quick naps.
It formed deep underground when crystal and earth were squeezed together over a very long time. It will not budge from its cave.
Carbink shines in the dark and leaves a glimmering trail. It shows great courage when its crystals are in danger.
A thin coating of slime keeps it moist, and it hates to be dried. It hides in the rain-soaked grass and wags its tiny horns at the sky.
Goomy has no bones, and it can squish itself through the narrowest cracks. It is shy and will melt away if it is scared.
It leaves a trail of acidic slime behind it and eats through the metal of any machine in its path. Its eyes are on the end of small horns.
Sliggoo lives in damp places and slides along silently. It hates the sun, and waits for a rainy day to come out.
It hugs those it loves with its arms, covering them in slime. It is tender-hearted and weeps if it is ignored.
Goodra's horns can sense danger and its soft body takes a blow without a scratch. It loves rainy days and joyful friends.
It likes keys of every shape and hoards them on its ring. If anyone tries to take its collection, it chases the thief with a jangle.
Klefki is said to guard a locked treasure, and it rattles when it moves. When it finds a lock that fits, it sparkles with joy.
It is the spirit of a child who got lost in the woods, which has taken the shape of a stump. It hides among roots and cries in the dark.
Phantump leads travelers astray with strange sounds in the forest. It is lonely, and just wants someone to stay.
It controls the trees around it with its roots and commands them to ensnare intruders. It is said to guard its forest with dark powers.
Trevenant stands silent in the shade of the woods. It is gentle to those who respect its home, but dreadful to those who do not.
It takes the shape of a lantern and wanders at night to guide lost souls. A flickering light shines from the gaps in its carved smile.
Pumpkaboo comes in many sizes, and each has its own mood. It sets itself ablaze and warns of danger in the dark.
It sings a sinister song at night, and those who hear it are rooted to the spot. Its many hands grope around in the black air.
Gourgeist floats through the dark from house to house. It pulls on the sleeves of passersby and giggles.
It is a lump of ice that shields itself with a cold, bitter air. It is so cold that touching it can freeze a fingertip.
Bergmite lives on frozen slopes and soaks up the chill. When it gets warm, its shell cracks and it shivers.
A huge slab of ice forms its back, and a group of smaller creatures rides along on top. It crushes anything in its way.
Avalugg tramps slowly across frozen lands. Its body is so heavy that the ground shudders as it goes.
It lives in caves and sends out sound waves that are too high to hear. They are strong enough to crumble stone if directed well.
Noibat hangs upside down at noon and flies out at night. With its ears, it never misses a sound in the dark.
It flies silently and unleashes shrieks that shatter rock. A blast of sound can knock a foe senseless in a heartbeat.
Noivern is a fierce hunter at dusk and a cunning ambusher. Its great wings carry it over a mountain in seconds.
It sleeps for a thousand years inside a tree, then wakes and shares everlasting life with the world. Its antlers shine like a rainbow.
Xerneas can give life to what it touches. When it walks, flowers bloom in its footprints.
When its life ends, it absorbs the life of everything around it, and then turns into a cocoon. It spreads its red wings and darkens the sky.
Yveltal is said to bring destruction wherever it flies. The beam from its wings drains the life out of those it hits.
It watches over the ecosystem from deep underground and keeps it in balance. When the order is threatened, it takes on its true shape.
Zygarde is made of many tiny cells that act as one. It protects nature from harm, and rarely shows itself.
A rare gem Pokémon with a sparkling body, it makes a glittering barrier of diamond. Its beauty is beyond price.
Diancie can create precious stones out of thin air. It is graceful and calm, and seldom speaks.
It is a mischievous prankster that can pull things through rings from far away. It likes to steal what it fancies.
Hoopa opens a hole in space with its hoop and snatches whatever it likes. Its powers grow wilder if it is angry.
It carries a great cloud of steam on its back and spews it out like a geyser. It sleeps in the mountains, away from prying eyes.
Volcanion can wipe out whole mountains with a blast of scalding steam. It hides in the caves and rarely meets anyone.
It sleeps on a branch during the day and stores sunlight in its feathers. At dawn it launches itself into the air with a silent glide.
Rowlet hides in a tree trunk and sneaks up on prey in silence. It is shy, but loves a warm pat on the head.
It can throw feathers like blades with a flick of its wing and hits a mark from far off. It is a proud, neat creature.
Dartrix preens itself with great care, and gets cross when its feathers are ruffled. It keeps its eyes peeled for threats.
It fires quills from its wings with deadly precision. In the quiet of night, it waits, still as a stone, until the right moment.
Decidueye hides its arrows in its feathers. It spots its foe from a distance and never misses.
It does not like to be touched, and prefers to keep to itself. Hairballs of fire come out when it grooms its fur.
Litten licks its fur to make it warm, and sparks fly off at times. It trusts only those who feed it well.
A bell at its neck glows when its flame rises, and it rings as it hits. It scratches its foe with burning claws.
Torracat has a hot temper and a stubborn streak. It is brave in a fight, but secretly likes to be petted.
It is a showy fighter that likes the spotlight and will go for the crowd's favor. It puts out flames from its belt with a flourish.
Incineroar gets restless in a fight and brawls with all its might. It does not take defeat well.
It balances a bubble on its nose and pops it for fun. Its voice is sweet, and it sings to cheer up its friends.
Popplio practices its tricks by the shore. It loves to perform for an audience and flops about in joy.
It dances on the waves with graceful moves and blows bubbles shaped like balloons. It aims to be a star of the sea.
Brionne sings in a sweet tone and moves with the music. Its song can charm a whole crowd.
It sings with the voice of an opera singer, and its notes form balloons of water that burst on a target. Its songs soothe the sea.
Primarina uses the power of its song to summon big waves. It has a heart of gold and a spirit of grace.
It pecks at tree trunks at a rate of sixteen times a second to make a nest. The noise is a clear sign that it is nearby.
Pikipek stores seeds in the holes it drills. It taps out its own rhythm to call other woodpeckers.
It stores berries in its large beak and blows out the seeds like a trumpet. Its call changes depending on the shape of its beak.
Trumbeak makes music with the juice and the pits of berries. It marks out its territory with a loud blast.
It fires a hot-tempered blast of fiery breath from its beak and strikes down enemies with a mighty shot. Its beak can heat up and glow.
Toucannon pecks and shoots like a cannon. It can see a target from a long way off.
It will eat nearly anything and has a bottomless appetite. It sits at the edge of a trail, patiently waiting for a snack to come along.
Yungoos has sharp front teeth that it uses to crack open a tough nut. It sleeps heavily at night and wakes up grumpy.
It stands motionless for hours, watching a spot where it expects prey to appear. It quickly tires, and often falls asleep on the job.
Gumshoos tracks by smell and follows a trail with a stubborn will. It walks with its back hunched and its eyes fixed ahead.
It digs through the soil with its strong jaws to reach the roots it likes. If it senses a threat, it spins a thread to hide.
Grubbin lives in the dark undergrowth and is not easily noticed. When a big storm blows in, it grabs hold of a root and waits.
Its body stores electricity like a battery, and it can power a lamp or a small machine. It fills up on sap and a charge from its friends.
Charjabug can be carried around as a source of power in an emergency. It hums as it rolls along the ground.
Big jaws grip an enemy, and a bolt of lightning flashes from its mouth. It zips around with a loud buzz and a gleam of blue.
Vikavolt has strong wings and a tough shell that will keep out most blows. It charges its jaws and fires a beam of power.
It has two big pincers that are shaped like fists, and it boxes with everything it meets. It waves them in the air and picks fights with the waves.
Crabrawler trains by punching rocks at the shore. It scuttles sideways, keeping its guard up.
Thick white fur covers its body and keeps it warm in the snow. It lives in the mountains and climbs steep icy slopes with its strong claws.
Crabominable swings its mighty arms and flattens a foe in one blow. It is called an abominable snowman by travelers who spot it.
It sips nectar from flowers, and the kind of flower decides the dance it performs. Its feathers brighten with the color of its favorite bloom.
Oricorio flutters through the air in graceful steps. A lively, passionate dance is how it greets the morning sun.
It can sense the aura of a flower and follows it to the best blooms. A cluster of them swarms about a field in a sparkling cloud.
Cutiefly is tiny and feather-light. It drinks nectar and rests on the head of larger Pokémon.
It gathers pollen and rolls it into puffballs that it carries about. Its wings beat so fast that it disappears and reappears.
Ribombee makes a ball of pollen and shares it with its friends. A big one is a prized gift to a fellow flyer.
It has a rocky nose that is very sturdy, and it digs and rubs it against stones. It gets very attached to its trainer and sticks close.
Rockruff runs everywhere with its tongue out and trips over its own paws. It is full of energy and tries to climb into laps.
It prowls the rocky slopes and moves with great speed and daring. The sharp rocks on its neck cut through whatever it grabs.
Lycanroc is loyal to a trainer it respects, and it fights with raw aggression. In the heat of a fight, it howls.
Alone, it is a weak and timid fish that is easily eaten. When it gathers with many others, they form a huge, fearsome shape.
Wishiwashi swims in huge shoals and calls out for help with a thin cry. Together, they will drive off even the biggest threat.
It hunts for coral and snacks on the creatures that live there. The spines on its body are tipped with poison.
Mareanie crawls across the sea floor and clings to rocks. It leaves tiny spikes that sting those who step on them.
Its many legs carry it over the sea floor, and the tips of its spines drip with a strong venom. Its shell is tough and protects it from all threats.
Toxapex lurks on the bottom of the sea. It deals a deadly sting to any who disturb it.
It has a lot of stamina and can haul a heavy load all day long. It loves to roll in mud and kicks up clods behind it.
Mudbray brays loudly when it is happy, and will sometimes bite its trainer's sleeve. It never forgets a kind face.
It pulls a loaded wagon with ease, and its mighty legs stamp the ground. Its hooves are as hard as bricks.
Mudsdale is steady and powerful, and it keeps its pace under a heavy burden. It kicks up mud that hardens like rock.
It wraps its head in a bubble of water and dives to hunt in ponds. The bubble holds enough air to last for a long time.
Dewpider stays in a clear stream and is a good swimmer. When it spots a threat, it hides under a leaf.
It carries a great bubble on its head and sets water-dwelling bug Pokémon inside to keep them safe. It spins a web in the shape of a bell.
Araquanid is gentle and guards its young at the water's edge. It hurls a ball of water at foes who wander in.
It soaks up sunlight with its leaf-like arms and then dozes in the shade. It lives alone and holds still to blend into the foliage.
Fomantis sways from side to side, as if on a breeze. It wakes at midday and sleeps through the night.
Its elegant blades look like petals, and it tends them as though they were precious gems. It keeps them sharp with great care.
Lurantis lashes out with the blades on its arms in a fight. It is fastidious about its looks and bathes in the morning dew.
It glows with a faint light in the dark, and the glimmer makes those who see it feel sleepy. It lives in the damp, still shade.
Morelull sprinkles drowsy spores from its cap. In the dim woods, you will see its lights bobbing like tiny lanterns.
Its glow draws lost travelers into the depths of the forest, where it feeds on their energy. It has an eerie, soft light.
Shiinotic waves its cap and the light dances across the woods. Many people have wandered in circles, hypnotized by its glow.
It gives off a poison gas from its body that smells sweet. It climbs rocks near volcanoes and is hard to spot.
Salandit shoots gas from its tail, and the cloud makes a creature faint. Males keep their distance.
It entices male Salandit with a scented gas and leads a harem of them. The more it commands, the more dazzling it becomes.
Salazzle slinks along rocks with a gliding, sassy walk. It strikes with a flick of its tail.
It looks cuddly and soft, but it flails around when it is upset and can hurt those who hold it. It loves to be hugged only by those it trusts.
Stufful tumbles about with arms swinging when it is scared or angry. When it calms down, it takes a snooze.
It hugs with arms strong enough to crush a person, and it gets so excited that it hurts those it likes. It never quite realizes its own strength.
Bewear is a gentle creature at heart, but a bear hug from it is enough to knock a man out. It looks for a friend to hold.
It gives off a sweet scent and sweat that tastes like fruit, which many creatures find tempting. It bounces around lightly.
Bounsweet is small and round, and bounces along on its toes. It can be quite cheeky and is often chased for its taste.
It kicks with its legs to knock out an opponent and keeps its guard up with a leafy crown. Its sweet scent is a lure.
Steenee is a sprightly sprinter that dashes off at a moment's notice. A tiny flower blooms on its head.
It kicks with great force and carries itself like a queen. It shows no mercy to those who show disrespect.
Tsareena struts with its head held high. A dignified, fruity air hangs around its long legs.
It carries a garland of flowers that it picks itself and wears with pride. The scent of its blooms soothes sick Pokémon.
Comfey makes friends with other Pokémon and gives them a flower. It dances happily when it feels at ease.
It is wise and quiet and tends to sit still, while its eyes follow everything. A leaf fan is waved about as it thinks.
Oranguru lives deep in the woods and gives advice to those who are lost. It keeps its distance from careless people.
It lives in a troop led by a strong boss, and they work together to pass fruit among themselves. They toss food and throw it with remarkable precision.
Passimian trains by hurling berries back and forth. A troop moves as one, in perfect step.
It is timid and scuttles away at the first sign of trouble, leaving a trail of sand. It hides in nooks along the shore.
Wimpod scours beaches for scraps and runs from any footstep. Despite its fear, it never loses sight of food.
It slices through foes with its sharp claws and defends itself with a hard shell. It is brave and fights with confidence.
Golisopod keeps a Wimpod beside it and trains the little ones. When it battles, it unfolds its arms and strikes.
It is born from a mound of sand and slips into the minds of those who step on it. Kids who get lured end up digging for hours.
Sandygast gathers on the shore and plays with children. If a shovel is left behind, it takes hold of it.
It builds a castle of sand and drains the energy of those who come near. Victims forget where they are, and dig until they drop.
Palossand lives on beaches and in deserts. It looks like a pile of sand, but a face peers out from the top.
It drifts on the shore at low tide and spits out its insides to defend itself. People tend to throw it back to the sea.
Pyukumuku lies about in the tidal pools. It looks lifeless, but is quite tough, and will punch with a stringy fist.
It was built to be a weapon, and a heavy helmet keeps its unstable power in check. Its eyes shine with a deep sadness.
Type: Null was made in a lab with parts of many creatures. It hardly speaks and moves in clumsy, heavy steps.
Once free of its helmet, it can change its type to counter any foe. It fights with a loyal heart beside those it trusts.
Silvally takes on the traits of the memory disc it holds. It wears a calm look, and its bond with a trainer is deep.
It lives high in the sky, and drops to earth when its shell grows too heavy. It rolls around like a meteor and spins on the ground.
Minior cracks open its shell in a bright flash of colors. It sleeps in the thin air above the clouds.
It never wakes up, and spends its whole life asleep with a log in its arms. Only a strong shock will stir it.
Komala dreams peacefully and drifts about with its eyes closed. It moves in its sleep and shows great stamina.
The spikes on its shell hold a volatile powder, and a hard knock sets off a blast. It lives beside volcanoes and shuns crowds.
Turtonator breathes a hot flame and detonates its own shell in a pinch. Afterward it hides to let the shell grow back.
Fright makes it curl into a prickly ball that snaps and crackles. It takes wires with its fur and comes away with a spark.
Togedemaru bobs along on short legs, waving its tail. It stores static in its quills and discharges it in times of fear.
It wears a handmade cloth that looks like another Pokémon and hides in dark places. It longs for friends, but fears what they would think.
Mimikyu scares off those who peek beneath its costume. Its cloth is stitched with care but its heart is lonely.
It gnashes its strong teeth to send waves of psychic force. The noise carries far, and fish in the area scatter.
Bruxish swims among the coral reefs and grinds its teeth with a clatter. Its colorful hue turns darker when it is angry.
It is gentle with children, and spends its days with the local ones, listening to their games. When roused, it shakes the sky with a roar.
Drampa floats along the slopes with a smile and keeps watch on a village. It does not fight unless its friends are hurt.
It is a restless soul that has taken over an old ship's anchor and moves it with seaweed. It sweeps the deep on stormy nights.
Dhelmise swings its heavy anchor in great arcs. Those who cross its path are dragged under the waves.
It clangs its scales together to make noise and show it is tough. It practices this to join the ranks of dragons of the mountain.
Jangmo-o is small, but it never gives up and keeps trying. When it is hungry, it clashes its scales to ask for food.
Its scales harden like armor and are sharp enough to cut. It keeps shedding them, and leaves them as it walks.
Hakamo-o chants a war cry that makes its scales ring. It trains by fighting in the mountains.
It shakes its tail to ring its armor and scare off foes. The sound is made to pose a challenge to enemies.
Kommo-o fights with honor and dignity and despises cowards. Its scales are used for charms, and they are cherished.
A guardian deity of an island, it is cheerful and quick to anger. It thrives on a good scrap and vanishes when it is done.
Tapu Koko flits about in a flash of electric light. It is playful, but its ferocity is fearsome when it is roused.
It scatters a glittering powder that can heal any wound. It is said to be fond of bright, pretty things and can be cruel.
Tapu Lele moves with a sparkling grace and a fickle temper. The scales it sheds bring good fortune.
It is a quiet guardian that sleeps in the deep jungle. It pulls plants from the soil to restore the wild, and lets nothing stand in the way.
Tapu Bulu wields a giant horn like a club and draws on the life of the land. It stalks through the grove with great calm.
It fills the air with a thick fog and leads the lost astray. It is a calm guardian that is kind to those who are pure of heart.
Tapu Fini cleanses poisoned waters with its touch. It slips from sight in the mist, and no one knows where it goes.
A wisp of gas that floats in the air, it is small and weak and shy. It sometimes sparkles with a faint, starry light.
Cosmog is as light as a puff of mist and easy to lose. It drifts without a trace and gathers stardust.
It is surprisingly heavy, but it hardly moves. It sleeps in a hard shell while it gathers strength to change.
Cosmoem is a stiff, silent cocoon of cosmic dust that sits where it was left. Inside the shell, something is slowly stirring.
It is said to come from another world, and the glow around its mane is that of the sun. It charges into the sky with thundering steps.
Solgaleo shines with a fierce brightness. Its mighty body radiates warmth, and it roars with the voice of the sun.
It spreads its wings and the sky turns dark, as if a night had come. It is said to wake from sleep under the light of the moon.
Lunala soaks up the moon's glow and sheds it as a cold blaze. It glides quietly through the dark.
It came through a tear in the sky and seeks a host to join with. Those it takes over turn aggressive and strange.
Nihilego drifts in the air like a jellyfish. Its toxins cause fits of rage in those who breathe them.
A strange visitor that flexes its muscles in front of any who see it. It cares only about getting stronger and boasts of its might.
Buzzwole punches with fists the size of boulders and shows off after every blow. It never tires of its own body.
It is a slim and swift being that moves too fast to be seen. A foe falls before it has registered an attack.
Pheromosa runs without stopping, and if it halts, it will weaken. Behind its delicate looks hides a vicious fighter.
A tall, thin creature with an electric glow. Its body is a mass of cables that twist and flash.
Xurkitree stands like a lamppost in the dark and shines brilliantly. Lightning crawls over its wiry limbs.
It is a gigantic mass of steel that can blast off like a rocket. It is thought to be a living plant that came from far away.
Celesteela's thick arms are said to be a pair of launching pads. It never moves unless it is attacked.
It is as thin as paper and sharper than a razor. It zips through the air and cuts down trees with no effort.
Kartana slashes with its arms like a pair of swords. It is a fragile thing that moves with great speed.
It swallows everything in its path, and never stops eating. Mountains and buildings vanish into its huge maw.
Guzzlord's belly seems bottomless. It digests garbage and metal alike, and then turns around and gulps down more.
A being of light that was hurt in a long-past battle, it craves brilliance and steals it from the world. Its form is hard as crystal.
Necrozma fires a beam that splits into prisms. It seeks the glow of the sky to heal itself.
It was built by an inventor long ago, and its heart is a glowing ball. It will wait patiently for the people it once served.
Magearna is a lifelike doll of steel and gold. It speaks with a gentle voice and shows great loyalty.
It lives in shadows and copies the moves of those it sees. It hides inside the shade of a person and lurks behind them.
Marshadow mimics the poses of others and then slips away. It is shy and watches from afar.
It carries a poison needle on its head and is clever and gentle. Its curiosity is endless, and it likes to prod new things.
Poipole is a small and friendly sort that shakes its stinger. It twirls about with a happy hum.
It has a long neck, and a pair of poisonous needles. It darts through the air at high speed.
Naganadel flits from the shadows in a flash, and its swift darting makes it hard to hit. Its stinger packs a heavy venom.
It is made up of a stack of bricks, and its form looks like a wall. It does not move unless it is bothered.
Stakataka gets up and charges when it senses danger. Its stone blocks glow when it fights.
A clown with a head that explodes, which it uses to surprise a crowd. Its performance is a joy to some and a terror to others.
Blacephalon juggles balls of fire and tosses its head about. Its laughter echoes in the dark.
It strikes with the speed of lightning and tears through foes with electric claws. It lands with a flash and leaves in a streak.
Zeraora crackles with power and bows its head to those it respects. It is bold and fierce in a fight.
It melts down metal and eats it as food, and its body is made of liquid steel. It travels in a swarm and sparks when it gets hungry.
Meltan is as small as a bolt and clings to power lines. It emits a faint, eerie hum.
It is a massive being made of steel that was built up from the bodies of many Meltan. It twists the metal into a hefty weapon.
Melmetal's might is enormous, and people of old looked up to it. It strikes the ground with a heavy thud.
It beats a rhythm on a stick it has found, and the tune makes plants grow lush and green. A cheerful, chatty monkey, it loves to bang away.
Grookey bangs its drumstick against the ground, and the beat spreads energy around it. It joins in with any group that is playing music.
It has two sticks and strikes up complicated rhythms with them. Each beat is timed to the movement of its feet.
Thwackey is picky about its drumsticks and spends hours finding a good one. Its beat can sway a whole forest.
It plays a heavy beat on a giant drum made of wood, and the whole woodland dances. Its fighting spirit rises with each stroke.
Rillaboom leads the forest with a deep, steady rhythm. When it drums, stumps sprout and trees grow thick.
It is full of energy and cannot stay still, and it dashes in all directions. It kicks pebbles for fun, and a small flame wakes in its feet.
Scorbunny practices its footwork even in its sleep. Its fur warms up quickly when it is running.
Its legs are strong and nimble, and it jumps high to dodge attacks. Soft fur on its body protects it from fire.
Raboot trains with fire in its paws and shows off its tricks. It is quick to get a big head over a win.
It lights a pebble on fire with its feet and kicks it into a blazing shot. It loves a game with a team and always plays with fairness.
Cinderace dribbles a burning ball and makes a quick turn. Its leaps are high and its aim is true.
It is a timid thing that cries when it is frightened, and its tears can make others cry as well. It turns invisible when it hides in the water.
Sobble keeps its eyes shut tight and shivers. When it is calm, it quietly blends into the pond.
It sets traps with water and watches from the shadows. It is clever and lazy, and prefers to let its tricks do the work.
Drizzile gets into scrapes and waits with a smug look. It enjoys a rainy day and calm, cool pools.
It fires a jet of water from a fingertip with pinpoint aim, and hits a target from beyond sight. Its sleek, silent movements fit a spy.
Inteleon keeps a cool head and plans each move ahead of time. It hides in shadow and then strikes with a single sharp shot.
It stuffs its cheeks with berries and hides the stash in a hole in the ground. It is a cheeky beggar that snatches snacks from picnic baskets.
Skwovet is always snacking and always hungry, and the fatter it gets, the slower it runs. It forgets where it hid its food.
Its great tail is used as a storage bin for berries, and it guards the hoard fiercely. It will fly into a rage if anyone tries to take a nibble.
Greedent never shares its food, and it gobbles the lot in a hurry if it fears a thief. Its cheeks are always packed.
It picks fights with much larger birds to prove its courage. It is hot-tempered and flaps in the face of anything bigger.
Rookidee has a keen eye and a sharp beak, and it is bold enough to dive at a foe. It hops along the ground, pecking at seeds.
It is smart and picks out shiny objects to stash in a hidden spot. It leads a flock with loud, clever calls.
Corvisquire hones its beak and hunts with care. It remembers anyone who has done it a favor, and who has not.
It wears a body of steel and serves as a flying taxi in the cities of its home. Its wings are wide enough to carry a grown man.
Corviknight patrols the sky and watches over travelers. It swoops with a fearsome cry whenever it finds a threat.
It spends its days hiding under a leaf and listening, because its antennae pick up sounds and signals from all around. It is a timid little creature.
Blipbug is weak when it is alone, and it follows other bugs for protection. Its tiny feelers twitch at every noise.
It hides in a shell, and its mind is quietly at work. Its dots flash a message, and a strange power comes from within.
Dottler rolls along slowly and reads minds by tuning in to others. It stays inside its shell for a long while and wakes up gradually.
It has seven spots, and each one holds a mighty power that it uses to read minds. It floats on a gentle breeze and watches from above.
Orbeetle sends out powerful waves that put others to sleep. It is wise and orderly and takes its time.
It muffles its steps with its fluffy tail and sneaks into places that are shut. It steals food, and the tail wipes out its tracks.
Nickit slips from shadow to shadow at night, hunting for scraps. When it is caught, it plays dead until the coast is clear.
It holds a grudge against the one who beat it and tracks that person across the whole region. It has a sharp nose for sniffing out hidden treasure.
Thievul moves at night and takes whatever shines. Its long tail is as wide as a rug and wipes out any sign of it.
It floats on a pond and sways to the rhythm of the water. It likes to sing and hums when the sun is on its petals.
Gossifleur spins about on the surface and spreads the news with a flower's gossip. It has a head full of petals and a lot to say.
The cotton on its head is soft and holds many seeds. Wind carries them far, and they sprout into new plants wherever they land.
Eldegoss spreads out its fluff when it is happy. Its cotton is used by people to make a soft, warm cloth.
It is covered in a bouncy coat of wool, and it can rebound off hills. When startled, it rolls down the slope and takes off at speed.
Wooloo grows a fleece that is used to make cozy clothes and bedding. It is gentle and a little slow.
Its fleece is dense and springy, and it can take a hit without harm. A kick from it can send a rival flying.
Dubwool has a ram's stubborn pride and a thick coat. It guards the flock with a brave, loud bleat.
Its jaw is strong, and it bites whatever is near when it is cranky or hungry. A small horn on its head is a sign of its temper.
Chewtle chomps down on a stranger's leg and won't let go. It is clumsy, but its shell is quite tough.
It lunges forward with a bite that can crush rock, and it hunts at the water's edge. A thick shell armors its back.
Drednaw pulls its head into its shell and rolls down hills. After a good meal, it sits on a rock to sun itself.
It runs about with a tail that gives off sparks. Its keen nose finds anything, and it brings back whatever it digs up.
Yamper barks cheerfully and bounds after a ball. It builds up charge as it runs, and zaps its trainer by accident.
It generates power by running, and it is among the fastest of its kind. A burst of speed leaves a trail of sparks.
Boltund runs at full tilt across the open field. It adores a good game of chase, and never tires of it.
It is a lump of coal that moves, and it rolls around the mines. It is shy, so it clings to its friends and rests in their warmth.
Rolycoly likes to hide in the dark, and miners often mistake it for a nugget. It leaves a trail of soot.
It burns hotter as it fights, and keeps its fire alive with coal. Its body warms a cold room.
Carkol uses its legs to roll and push with great strength. Lumps of fiery coal crumble off it as it goes.
It burns with a great blaze on its back, and it runs as hot as a furnace. In a snowy region, villages gather around it for warmth.
Coalossal is an enormous hill of coal that climbs up the slope to meet the day. A beast of fire, it is gentle at heart.
It lives inside an apple, and it nibbles on the flesh as it grows. If its home is eaten, it must find a new one.
Applin hides in a fruit to stay safe from birds. The sweet smell draws others that want a bite.
It flits about on little wings and splashes a sour juice. Its apple has been carefully picked to match its taste.
Flapple dives from high branches and bites with its tart apple. It grows grumpy when it is hungry.
It lets out a sweet nectar that attracts a crowd, and it is as sticky as honey. It is a slow, gentle thing that likes to doze.
Appletun's body oozes with a sugary syrup. It snoozes in the sun beneath an apple tree.
It slithers beneath the dunes and shoots sand from its nose to blind an enemy. It sneezes out a cloud when it is surprised.
Silicobra lives in the dry wastes and sleeps buried in the sand. Its tail sweeps the desert smooth.
It coils into a tight spiral and whirls sand into a storm. The sand in its body keeps it warm in the cold of night.
Sandaconda is huge and proud and shows off its coils in the sun. It can fling a tornado of dust at a foe.
It is a bird with a hearty appetite that swallows its prey whole. Sometimes it forgets what it was doing right after it takes a gulp.
Cramorant dives for fish and gets distracted. It spits out whatever it caught in a quick shot.
It is a fish with a sharp snout that is always on the hunt. It rushes at its prey with a dart and often gets stuck in the sand.
Arrokuda is a very fast swimmer but not a careful one. It spears a meal and has to wriggle free.
It rockets through the water like a missile and pierces its prey with its pointed face. It is so fast that its path leaves a streak.
Barraskewda goes after anything that moves and is feared by fishermen. Its sharp fins cut like blades.
It stores poison in its body, and when it stays on the move it makes a spark. It is a restless baby that loves to bounce.
Toxel cries when it is hungry, and its tears crackle with power. It mimics the noise of others.
It plays on the strings of its body like a guitar, and the sound is loud and wild. Its fans leap and shout at its shows.
Toxtricity strikes a chord to shoot out a jolt of poison. Every performance ends with a thundering finale.
It warms its body with the heat of the sun and stores the fire in its legs. It winds around a foe and fries it with its heat.
Sizzlipede heats up its body and hides in a rock. It gives off a sizzling sound when it is angry.
It coils around its prey and cooks it with a blast of heat. When it gets agitated, its long body turns red hot.
Centiskorch is a great, blazing worm that burns up the dry grass. Its fangs and its legs glow with fire.
It has strong arms that it likes to swing about, and it gets into fights with ease. It takes a grip on a rock and doesn't let go.
Clobbopus tests its strength against anything it finds. It throws a tantrum when it loses.
It grabs foes with all eight of its arms and performs smooth throws. It spends its days training to refine its holds.
Grapploct challenges strong opponents to a bout. It is a deft fighter that wins with technique.
It hides in a cup, and if you drink the tea, you may be cursed. A spirit stirs inside, and a ghostly hand reaches out for a sip.
Sinistea is found in old teapots and cups. It rests quietly in the dust until someone disturbs it.
It lives in a teapot and pours out a spirit brew. It only appears when it feels that the tea is of fine taste.
Polteageist hates a cheap blend, and it will throw a fit if the quality is poor. Its body is a swirl of steam.
It senses the feelings of others through the antennae on its head. It hates a crowd, and goes to quiet corners to be alone.
Hatenna is shy and runs from noise. The ribbons on its head wave in a gentle breeze.
It lashes out at noise with a strong blow of its hair, and the sudden attack is more than most can bear. It wants to be left in peace.
Hattrem lives in a quiet glen and does not like to be disturbed. Its fine hair is a weapon and a shield.
It drains the energy of those who fight near it, and its long hair tangles around them. It rules over a silent forest.
Hatterene hates a noisy quarrel and punishes those who make one. Its power is deep and strange.
It sneaks around at night and plays tricks on people. A bit of mischief draws out the sap of its long nose.
Impidimp likes to bother others, and feeds on their annoyance. It runs away giggling when it is spotted.
It stalks through the dusk with a sneaky smile and pulls a fast one on the unwary. The tuft of hair on its head is its most prized feature.
Morgrem hums as it works some mischief. It likes to take a nap among thorns and hides away if it senses a trap.
Hair is wound around its arms like cords, and it can pump up its muscles to a huge size. It is tough and cunning, but looks after its friends.
Grimmsnarl slaps its foes with its wiry hair and trains the little ones of its kind. It is gruff, but kind at heart.
It plants itself in the way and lets out a bellow that scares off an enemy. It crosses its arms and refuses to give any ground.
Obstagoon stands like a wall, with a stripe of white across its chest. It marches into a fight and holds the line.
It wears a helmet of hard metal and attacks with a savage fury. A fierce warrior at heart, it does not take well to losing.
Perrserker stomps into a fray and swings its blades. Its shiny armor is polished daily.
Its body is made of coral that was changed by a curse, and it lashes at the living with its branching arms. It grieves over what it lost.
Cursola drifts in the shallows with a wounded, hollow look. Its glow is cold and pale.
It guards the leek that has been passed down through its family, and it fights with it like a lance. Only the best of its kind can bear the title.
Sirfetch'd is honorable and brave, and it is always ready to defend its home. Its shield is a battered, well-used thing.
It performs a lively tap dance and juggles chunks of ice. Its act is sometimes met with applause and sometimes with a chill.
Mr. Rime makes jokes in a deadpan manner and stages a show for the crowd. Its cane lets it freeze the ground in a flash.
It is made from an old clay tablet that has been given a new life by a restless spirit. It holds a grudge against anyone who disturbs the ruins.
Runerigus lumbers about with a mournful stare. The symbols on its body glow if its past is touched.
It is made of sweet cream and floats in the air with a dreamy look. The smell of it draws a crowd of hungry creatures.
Milcery changes in flavor depending on what it eats and the dance it sees. It melts quickly in the heat.
It decorates itself with fine cream and berries and spins in a dance. Its moods can be told from the sweetness of its taste.
Alcremie is a delight to bakers and customers. It rests in a cool place, and its swirl of cream is neat and tall.
It is a group of six that marches in step, and each member has a role in the formation. The one in front gives the orders.
Falinks bangs its shield as it advances, and the rest follow with a shout. If one of them is hurt, the formation is reorganized at once.
It shoots sparks from its spines and shocks any foe that tries to step on it. It crawls along the seabed picking at algae.
Pincurchin is spiky and sharp, and its colors are a warning. It tucks in and shivers when it is nervous.
It hides under leaves and snow and munches on fallen berries. It spits string to protect itself, and its thread is cold to the touch.
Snom is a tiny, round worm that clings to the underside of a branch. It shivers if it is warmed by the sun.
It glides over the snowy ground with icy wings that scatter frost. It lives in a bitter-cold place and loves a blizzard.
Frosmoth flaps its wings and a flurry of ice crystals blows out. It rests in the hollow of a snow-laden tree.
A ring of standing stones in a field has a life of its own, and it moves in the night. It trudges back to its spot at dawn.
Stonjourner walks to the place where the sun shines on it the most. It rests there until it must move again.
It wears a block of ice on its head that keeps it cool and shields it from harm. It dives into the cold sea, sliding on its belly.
Eiscue is comfortable in the chill and goes wherever the water is coldest. When the ice thaws, it hurries to refreeze it.
It senses the feelings of others and tries to lend a hand. A kind and caring Pokémon, it sticks to its master's side.
Indeedee reads minds through the horns on its head and acts as a loyal servant. It serves tea and tidies the house.
It has a sweet look when it is full and a fierce one when it is hungry. It stores seeds in its cheeks and burns energy if it gets low.
Morpeko switches moods as its belly empties. It will fight over a seed, and is always on the lookout for more.
It digs up ore with its trunk and eats it. The metal it consumes makes its skin turn green with age.
Cufant is a gentle giant, and lumbers along in a herd. It walks with a steady stride and sprays water with its trunk.
Its weight and strength are legendary, and it hauls huge loads of stone and wood. Miners have trained it to carry their goods through the pass.
Copperajah swings its trunk like a hammer. In the hot sun it sprays a cool mist of water on itself.
It was revived from a fossil that was put together in the wrong way, and its body is out of balance. It runs faster than most, but cannot hunt well.
Dracozolt is quick and strong, and its power is fierce. Its movement is awkward since its parts do not fit together.
Its body is a patchwork of parts, with ice in its chest. It shakes off sparks and frost with each step.
Arctozolt lumbers about in a bad mood. The ice on its body never melts, and it does not seem to feel the cold.
It has strong legs and a powerful jaw, but it can't breathe in the water. Its bite is so strong that it can crunch through bone.
Dracovish is a fossil fish that was made to walk on land. It lunges at a meal with an ugly snap.
A strange mix of parts, it can swim though it has no way to breathe. Its jaws make a fine stew of anything it catches.
Arctovish lurks in cold waters and breathes out a chilly mist. Its fins are as sharp as knives.
A light yet tough alloy forms its frame, and it hardly ever rusts. It lives on a high cliff and watches the horizon.
Duraludon is a tall, sleek dragon with a gleaming shell of alloy. Its fierce eyes rarely blink.
It was born in the ancient seas and drifts as a ghost through the air. It sticks to the back of other Pokémon and sips their energy.
Dreepy flies slowly in the gloom, searching for something it has lost. It lives in the dark and moves in silence.
It guards its young and makes sure they are safe. It carries a Dreepy in its horn and searches for the best spot to rest.
Drakloak is a patient nanny that shows great devotion to its charge. It flits across the sky at night.
It fires its young like missiles from the horns on its head. The little ones race out and bite at a foe with great glee.
Dragapult hides in a cloud and strikes without being seen. It is a swift hunter with a ghostly presence.
A wolf that was once a hero and carries a sword in its mouth. When it grips the blade, its coat flows in the wind and it becomes invincible.
Zacian leaps into battle with a fearless howl. The sword it holds is said to cut through anything.
A wolf that was once a hero and wears a shield on its body. Under threat, its mane flares up like flames.
Zamazenta stands firm and shrugs off any blow. It is said to have stood against a great darkness.
It fell from space long ago and lay in a crater for ages. It absorbs the energy of the land and grows ever bigger.
Eternatus sleeps below the earth with a glowing core. When it wakes, the sky turns dark and the ground shakes.
It trains daily at a secluded tower, practicing a martial art. It is a young and serious student that has no time to play.
Kubfu bows to its master and practices with an iron will. It wears a long scarf that flutters as it moves.
A master of fighting that trains hard day and night to improve. It uses its mighty fists in a dazzling style.
Urshifu leaps into the air and lands blows with the force of a storm. Disciplined and humble, it shares its skills.
It lives in a deep forest and leads a troop of its own kind. It swings from tree to tree on vines and guards its home with ferocity.
Zarude shakes its vines and lashes out with force. It will do anything to protect its family.
It is a being of pure energy, and it can move at lightning speed. Electrons spin in its body, and it makes a loud buzz.
Regieleki runs so fast that it blurs. It sleeps among old ruins in a dull glow.
Its arms are in the shape of a dragon's head, and it holds the ancient power of a dragon. Old stories say it was sealed away in a ruin.
Regidrago is a giant made of dragon energy. It roars with a deep, rumbling voice.
It is a horse covered in a thick coat of ice, and it charges across the snow with a great force. The cold from its body freezes the air.
Glastrier gallops with a heavy hoof and drives ahead without slowing. Its frozen mane glitters like a shield.
A ghostly horse that races through the night, and a gloomy cry comes from it. It cannot be seen except in the dark of the moon.
Spectrier is a restless spirit that runs as fast as the wind. It hunts for a soul to take.
A tiny king that was once loved by the people of the land. It tends to the plants in the fields and brings good harvests.
Calyrex wears a crown of flowers, and listens to those who need help. A kind ruler, it is also a wise one.
The orbs on its antlers can shake a foe's mind with strange waves. It walks among the snow-covered hills.
Wyrdeer lives in herds, and the antlers on its head are a sign of age. It has a calm and proud air.
It swings a stone axe at its enemies, and the axe has been passed down for generations. It rules a mountain forest and is easily provoked.
Kleavor carves out its territory with sweeping strokes. When enraged, it is a terrifying sight.
Its large body is wrapped in a coat of thick fur, and it moves with a heavy tread. It is gentle by nature but a fierce fighter when provoked.
Ursaluna roams the marshes and keeps to itself. It has a keen sense and finds berries by the scent.
It swims upstream against a raging current, driven on by the spirits of its fellows. Those who drowned in the river swim alongside it.
Basculegion leaps over rapids with a powerful sweep of its tail. It is hard to tell whether it is a living fish or a ghost.
It climbs sheer cliffs with ease using its sharp claws, and it grabs a rare flower from the peak. The poison on its claws can fell a big foe.
Sneasler is a daring hunter with a bold attitude. It prefers to work alone and distrusts a stranger.
The spines that cover its body are loaded with venom, and it can shoot them at a foe. It twirls through the water like a spinning top.
Overqwil dives in the dark depths of the sea and spears its prey. It is dangerous to touch, and fishermen steer clear.
It brings the warm winds of spring and lets plants awaken. Its mood changes fast, from tender to stormy, and the weather follows.
Enamorus floats on a cloud and sheds a rain of petals. Those who meet it are charmed, and some are driven wild.
A sweet scent drifts from its fur, and it uses the smell to lure people closer. Then, it purrs and bats at them with a playful paw.
Sprigatito is a mischievous cat with a leaf on its head. It likes to be admired, and gets cross if ignored.
It tosses a flower to whoever catches its eye, and the scent from the bloom puts them in a good mood. It is graceful and a little vain.
Floragato slinks along with a swing of its tail. It is quick to pounce when it sees an opening.
It pulls a bouquet from thin air to charm a crowd, and it strikes while they look at it. Its hand is quicker than the eye.
Meowscarada is a showman and loves a grand finish. It leaps from the stage, and a cloud of petals follows.
It lazes around in the sun and sleeps with its mouth open, and a faint fire flickers inside. It is a cheerful, carefree sort.
Fuecoco is easygoing and keeps a lazy pace. It gets lively at mealtime, and snaps at food with great glee.
It heats up its body to stay warm and stokes the fire in its belly with a hearty meal. The flames on its head burn brighter when it is hungry.
Crocalor sways with a leisurely stride. A bit of a bully, it puffs out smoke when it is in a bad mood.
It sings a beautiful tune that stirs up a ghostly fire. The fire on its head dances along with the notes.
Skeledirge soothes its allies with a calming voice, while it drives foes to despair. A skull on its head glows with a pale flame.
It is a well-mannered duckling that practices its moves with great care. It is always neat and tidy, and washes itself every morning.
Quaxly stands upright and tries to look dignified. It likes to splash in the shallows and dabble for food.
It does its exercises in the early morning and dances with water in its hands. Its steps are neat and well timed.
Quaxwell is keen to improve and often stays up to practice. It wears its crest with pride.
It dances with a dazzling flourish and fights in time to a rhythm. Each kick is placed to the beat.
Quaquaval loves to be the center of attention. Its graceful whirl sweeps water in a wide arc.
It sniffs about all day and finds food by smell alone. Its nose is so keen that it does not need its eyes.
Lechonk is always looking for a snack and often walks into things. It follows the smell of food without a care.
It gives off a sweet scent from its body, and its perfume is made of herbs and flowers. A drop of it is prized by many.
Oinkologne trots confidently, and the aroma follows. It keeps its coat clean and well groomed.
It is wrapped in a ball of thread that keeps it safe and warm. When it falls, it bounces and rolls to safety.
Tarountula spins a silk case and tucks itself in. It dangles on a thread from a tree branch.
It sets up traps and hangs by a thread from a high place. It waits quietly until a meal is caught.
Spidops is a careful hunter and leaves nothing to chance. It fixes its web every day.
It is small, but its legs are strong and it can jump high. It folds them up when it is relaxing in the grass.
Nymble leaps about in a flurry and taps the ground with its feet. If it feels threatened, it jumps away in a flash.
It kicks with its powerful legs and strikes the foe with a blow that is hard to see coming. Its sharp eyes miss nothing.
Lokix springs from the shadows and moves at astonishing speed. It is a skilled fighter that rarely stops.
Electricity gathers in its paws, and it puts out a small jolt with every pat. It is cute, but it can sting when it is angry.
Pawmi rubs its hands together to make sparks. It scampers about and clings to its trainer's hair.
It massages its trainer's shoulders with its paws, and gives them a little jolt of power. It is fond of those it likes.
Pawmo stands up on two legs and punches with its charged hands. It works hard at its training.
It moves with great speed and dashes at a foe with a quick flurry of punches. A thunderous clap follows each blow.
Pawmot is a sturdy fighter that trusts in its fists. It is calm until it is time for a fight.
It always travels with a partner, and the two keep close and never separate. They share their food and rest by turns.
Tandemaus pairs off and lives as a couple. If one is lost, the other will search all over for it.
A family of mice that moves as a group, with a mother, a father and two young. They carry food home to share with each other.
Maushold scurries around as a tight-knit clan. They use their paws to pick up and hand over food.
It is a puppy made of dough that gives off a yeasty scent. It is so soft that you can knead it, and it warms up when it is happy.
Fidough follows its trainer with its tail wagging. The more it is petted, the fluffier it gets.
It has baked itself to a golden-brown crust, and its body is crispy outside and warm inside. It keeps an eye on its master's home.
Dachsbun is a loyal and protective dog that loves a good meal. Its long body wiggles when it runs.
It carries an olive on its head and presses it for oil that is used in cooking. The oil is bitter at first, and sweet after a time.
Smoliv is a small and cheerful seedling that grows slowly. It spends sunny days sitting still.
Its oil is rich and smooth and is used to treat sore skin. It carries a pair of fruits on its back and shares them with friends.
Dolliv grows in orchards and is tended by farmers. It rubs oil on its fur to keep it glossy.
It forms a lush tree with olives that ripen in the sun. It is calm and kind, and it shares the harvest with everyone.
Arboliva gives off a pleasant, herbal scent. Its oil is prized for flavoring and is said to heal.
It lives in flocks and screeches at the top of its lungs. The color of its feathers decides which group it belongs to.
Squawkabilly is rowdy and quarrelsome, and it fights over food. It follows a leader and flies in a noisy crowd.
It is a cube of salt that came to life, and it lives in a cave where the rock is salty. It shines white in the dark.
Nacli loves to hide in the crevices of a wall. A lick of its body tastes of salt.
It is a tower of salt blocks that stands tall, and a pile of them moves in a line. It trudges with heavy steps.
Naclstack collects salt from the earth and builds itself up. Its stack leans a little when it walks.
It sprinkles salt on a wound and speeds its recovery. It makes the salt from the rock of a cave and keeps it as a treasure.
Garganacl stands firm with a gleaming body of salt. It is a gentle and protective giant.
It is born from the embers of a burned-out fire and wears armor of charcoal. A small flame flickers on its head.
Charcadet is an eager young warrior that trains with a stick. It dreams of a mighty blade.
It wears armor made of a hot, red material and wields a flame like a sword. Its heart is brave and it helps those in need.
Armarouge fights with a graceful, flaring burst of psychic fire. Its armor was made by a mighty hand.
Two blades of blue fire grow from its arms, and they flare when its anger rises. It lives to avenge a wrong from long ago.
Ceruledge burns with a grim spirit and attacks without mercy. Its armor is stained with ash.
It lights up the tip of its tail like a lamp, and sends signals to its friends. It lives in ponds and glows brightly after dark.
Tadbulb is a restless baby that dashes about. It flashes faster when it is excited.
It swells up its belly to store a huge charge, and the croak it makes is a booming clap. It stays still in its marsh and pulls prey in.
Bellibolt has a big, round belly full of electric power. A hop from it makes the ground shake.
It flies over the sea in a storm and makes electricity as it flaps. It is quick and small and rides on a gale.
Wattrel dives for fish with a sizzling dart. It sleeps on a rock when the weather is calm.
It spreads its great wings and rides the wind far out to sea. A charge of electricity gathers around it as it soars.
Kilowattrel sings with a loud cry as it dives. It has a bright, yellow chest that shines in the sun.
It uses a sly look to take its master's lunch. A gruff little rascal, it leads the other dogs on a merry chase.
Maschiff loves to play tricks and drag things about. It has a scar over one eye that gives it a tough look.
It guards its boss with a ferocious bark and the biggest scowl. It has a loyal heart and follows its leader to the end.
Mabosstiff is a stern guard that never lets its charge out of its sight. Its glare can make a thief freeze.
It lives in hidden corners of towns and has a taste for rubbish. It flicks its tail to spray a harmless-looking, but nasty, venom.
Shroodle is a cheeky creature that snatches scraps and runs. Its fur is dull and grimy, but its eyes are quick.
It scribbles on trees and rocks with a venom from its fingers, and every one of its drawings is different. It is a talented artist, but a bit messy.
Grafaiai dips its paws in poison and paints on rocks. It uses its long limbs to climb through the treetops.
It rolls over the dry earth and gathers up loose brush as it goes. It is the spirit of a weed that a traveler left behind.
Bramblin tumbles along in the wind and follows people who walk the road. It hides in a heap of dry twigs.
It unrolls its thorny vines to grab hold of the living and pulls them in. Its eerie, hollow face peers out of the tangle.
Brambleghast drifts like a ghostly weed and loosens its branches in a rustling heap. It is a lonely spirit that seeks company.
It walks on two thin legs, with a big cap of mushroom on top. It soaks up the damp and sleeps in shady places.
Toedscool pads about on soggy ground and leaves tracks in the mud. Its cap is dotted with delicate gills.
It sways its long tendrils to catch what drifts by, and it casts a fine mist of spores. It lurks in a gloomy, wet forest.
Toedscruel has a wide cap and a bunch of waving feelers. It wanders about in the fog, moving slowly.
It hangs upside down from a cliff and waits for prey to pass by. When it spots a meal, it lets go and snaps its claw shut.
Klawf sits in its hole all day and flexes its pincer. It turns red with anger when someone gets too close.
It is a sprout that tingles on the tongue. Those who handle it with bare hands may find their skin burning.
Capsakid stands in the sunshine and basks in the heat. It flicks its stem and lets off a peppery puff.
One head is spicy and the other is sweet, and they quarrel over everything. A bite of its flesh can set your mouth ablaze.
Scovillain shoots fire from its hot head and sprays a sugary mist from its sweet one. The two heads rarely agree.
It rolls a ball of dung bigger than itself across the ground. It pushes with all its might and covers its precious ball with a layer of sand.
Rellor makes a ball with care and takes it home to a hole. It works hard and is proud of its job.
It lives inside a sphere, and its mind is tuned to the tiny world around it. It watches from within a round shell and moves it by thought.
Rabsca rides on a ball and spins as it goes. It sends out a mysterious wave from a pair of eyes.
Its frill is covered in tiny feathers that lets it float above the ground. It zips through the grass and darts away with a trill.
Flittle is a timid and swift runner. It uses its psychic power to fly a short way.
It stares at its prey with glowing eyes and sends out a wave that freezes it in place. Then it kicks at a speed beyond belief.
Espathra lashes out with strong legs and runs at a furious pace. Its large eyes are made for hunting by night.
It makes a hammer from a piece of metal it has found, and it swings the hammer with a merry clink. Its work is crude but fills it with joy.
Tinkatink is a little smith that hammers away and hums. It carries a lump of iron to use for repairs.
It forges a hammer that is perfectly balanced and swings it with great skill. It is fiercely proud of the work of its hands.
Tinkatuff clangs away in its workshop with a steady rhythm. It scowls at anyone who touches its tools.
